title: Tata Motors among 5 stocks closing above 200-DMA - Trend watch | The Economic Times
text:
On November 17, five Nifty500 stocks gained over 3% and closed above their respective 200-day moving averages (DMA), according to StockEdge’s technical scan data.

The 200-DMA is a widely tracked technical indicator used to assess a stock’s long-term price trend. A close above this moving average is generally considered a bullish signal, suggesting that the stock may be transitioning into an upward trend.
